title: BlockFlow script file
description: A workflow as a list of steps (the recommended format to write by hand or with an LLM). A step continues to the next one from "out" (loops: "done"); after an If, the next step follows the end of each branch. Generated by scripts/scriptSchema.ts.

id.description: In a file of several scripts: lets Run Workflow name this script.

start.description: Start: Start here when you press Run, with some starting values (also defaults for Run Workflow).

timer.description: Timer: Start the flow on a schedule, or delay it when placed after another block.

seconds.description: Under 30 seconds the extension keeps its background worker awake to fire on time (Chromium). 30 seconds or more uses browser alarms. After another block: waits up to 600 s inside the run; longer delays continue as a new run.

repeat.description: Only used when this block starts the flow. After another block it always fires once.

schedule.description: Schedule: Start the flow at set times: daily at 09:00, on weekdays, every hour, every N minutes.

at.description: For "day". Local time of this computer.

days.description: For "day": every day, weekdays, weekends, or names: mon, wed, fri.

minutes.description: For "N minutes". Runs on the clock (:00, :15, :30…).

page-visited.description: Page Visited: Start when you open a matching page (in any tab). That tab becomes "main".

url.description: Plain text = the URL contains it; * any part between slashes; ** anything; /…/ regex.

context-menu.description: Context Menu: Add an item to the right-click menu that starts the flow on that page.

watch-element.description: Watch Element: Fire when the text of a part of a web page changes.

intervalSeconds.description: Only used when this block starts the flow. After a Timer, the Timer decides. Under 30 seconds keeps the background worker awake.

reload.description: Needed to see server-side changes. Turn off for pages that update themselves.

emitOnFirstRead.description: Off = the first read just records the starting value.

open-url.description: Open Tab: Open a web page, and remember the tab for the next blocks.

url.description: Use {{name}} to insert a value from the previous block.

tab.description: Later blocks find the tab by this name. Use another name (e.g. "admin") for a second tab.

active.description: Off = open quietly in the background.

navigate.description: Navigate: Go to a URL, back, forward, or reload, in a tab of this run.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

wait-for-popup.description: Wait for Popup: Catch a new tab or window the page opened, and name it for the next blocks.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

close-tab.description: Close Tab: Close a tab this run opened.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

click.description: Click: Click (or double-click, right-click, hover) an element. Waits until it can be clicked.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

force.description: Click even if the element looks hidden, disabled or covered. Only for stubborn pages.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

fill.description: Fill: Type a value into a text field. Works with React, Vue and Angular forms.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

fill-form.description: Fill Form: Fill several fields at once: text, selects, checkboxes. Optionally click submit.

fields.description: Empty values are skipped. Selects take the option text or value; checkboxes take true or false.

submit.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

select-option.description: Select Option: Choose an option in a dropdown (<select>), by its text or value.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

value.description: Several for a multi-select: separate with |

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

check.description: Check: Tick or untick a checkbox, radio button or switch. Does nothing if it already is.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

press-key.description: Press Key: Press a key or shortcut: Enter, Tab, Escape, Control+A…

key.description: Key names as on the keyboard: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, ArrowDown, a, Control+A, Shift+Tab.

locator.description: Focus this element first. Empty = whatever has focus.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

upload-file.description: Upload File: Choose a file for a file input, without the file dialog: text you write, or a file from a URL.

locator.description: The <input type="file"> (hidden ones work too), or its label.

filename.description: Empty with a URL = the name in the URL.

mime.description: For "text". With a URL the server says.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

scroll.description: Scroll: Scroll to the bottom, top or an element; or keep scrolling until no more content loads.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

dialogs.description: Dialogs: Answer alert / confirm / prompt boxes automatically, or read what they said.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

wait-for.description: Wait For: Wait until an element appears or goes, some text shows, the URL changes, or the page settles.

locator.description: For the element modes. For text: only look inside this element (optional).

url.description: Plain text: the URL contains it. * matches any part between slashes, ** anything. /…/ is a regular expression. Also the request address for "a network request finishes".

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

run-script.description: Run Script: Run your own JavaScript in the page; its return value is saved. Chrome 135+.

code.description: An async function body: use await, read `data`, and `return` a JSON value.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

read-element.description: Read Element: Read a value from a page: text, attribute, class, whether it exists, or how many.

url.description: BlockFlow opens it in its own background tab. Leave empty to read the run's tab instead (see Tab).

tab.description: Used when Page URL is empty: read from this tab of the run (from Open Tab), as it is now, without reloading.

name.description: Only for "an attribute" and "has a class".

extract-list.description: Extract List: Scrape repeated items (cards, results, rows) into a list of objects.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

fields.description: No fields = each item's text as {text}. Links (href, src) come back as full URLs.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

extract-table.description: Extract Table: Read an HTML table into a list of rows, keyed by its column headers.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

paginate.description: Paginate: Run "each" on every page of a paged list, clicking Next in between.

locator.description: CSS, or text=…, role=…[name="…"], label=…, placeholder=…, testid=…, A >> B, >> nth=0. Or press 🎯 Pick.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

page-info.description: Page Info: Read the page itself: title, meta tags, JSON-LD, or its localStorage / cookies.

key.description: Storage and cookies: one key. Empty = all of them.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

page-snapshot.description: Page Snapshot: Outline of what is on the page (roles, names, a locator for each element), to write steps from or keep with the run.

locator.description: Only this element and what is inside it. Empty = the whole page.

maxLines.description: Long pages are cut here, with a note.

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

assert.description: Assert: Check that something is true. Fails the run (or just records it, if soft) when it is not.

value.description: Only for "a value from the data".

operator.description: Not used by the yes/no checks (visible, checked…).

soft.description: Soft: record the failure but keep going

tab.description: The name an Open Tab block gave the tab earlier in this run. Usually "main".

manual-step.description: Manual Step: Pause until you press Continue: solve a CAPTCHA, type a 2FA code, take a look.

stop.description: Stop: End this path here: as passed, or as failed with a message.

if.description: If: Go one way when a condition is true, another when it is false.

right.description: Ignored by "is empty", "is true" and similar. For a pattern, write /text/i.

switch.description: Switch: Go one of several ways: the first case that matches the value picks the output, else "default".

cases.description: Each case is an output named after it (letters, digits, "_" and "-"; not "default", "error", "out" or "done"). No match goes to "default". For a pattern, write /text/i.

for-each.description: For Each: Repeat the blocks on "each" for every item of a list, then continue from "done".

list.description: Where the list is in the data, e.g. items or data.results (an expression, no {{ }}).

repeat.description: Repeat: Run the blocks on "each" a number of times, or until / while a condition holds, then continue from "done".

left.description: Until / while: rendered at every check against the data the last time ended with ({{iteration}} = times run so far).

run-workflow.description: Run Workflow: Run another workflow with this data, and continue with what it returns.

workflow.description: Its start blocks receive this data. It does not need to be On.

set-variable.description: Set Variable: Add a value to the data flowing through.

transform.description: Transform: Compute new values with expressions: math, text, lists (sum, sort, pluck…).

values.description: Expressions without {{ }}. See docs/guide for the functions.

filter.description: Filter: Keep only the list items that match a condition.

list.description: Where the list is in the data, e.g. items or data.results (an expression, no {{ }}).

left.description: Rendered for each item: {{item.…}} is the item, other {{…}} the data.

data-table.description: Data Table: Rows of data you paste in (CSV or JSON), e.g. logins to test one by one.

text.description: CSV with a header row (comma, semicolon or tab), or a JSON list.

save-dataset.description: Save to Dataset: Add rows to a named dataset kept in the browser. See and download it on the Data page.

value.description: An expression: a list adds one row per item, anything else one row. E.g. items, or item inside a For Each. Build objects with Transform first.

download.description: Download: Save a list or a dataset to a CSV or JSON file in Downloads.

value.description: An expression, for "a value from the data".

http-request.description: HTTP Request: Call an API or webhook and use the response.

headers.description: One per line, as  Name: value

body.description: Sent for POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

failOnError.description: Stop the flow on HTTP errors (4xx, 5xx)

log.description: Log: Write a line to the run log, e.g. a value you want to see.
